title: Notifications
unreadN: {n, plural, one {1 new message} other {# new messages}}

contact_declined.title: {name} declined
contact_declined.body: Your contact request about “{title}” was not accepted.

join_declined.title: Request declined
join_declined.body: “{group}” did not accept your join request.

working_group.title: New working group
working_group.body: There is now a group to carry out “{title}”.

initiative_passed.title: Initiative passed
initiative_passed.body: “{title}” now goes to the responsible office.

request_forwarded.title: Request forwarded
request_forwarded.body: Your request is now with another body.

responsibility_request.title: New request for you
responsibility_request.body: Someone contacted one of your responsibilities. A deadline is running.

content_hidden.title: One of your posts was hidden
content_hidden.body: After review by the citizen jury, case {case_no}.

vouched.title: {by} vouches for you
vouched.body: With two vouches you become verified. “Rights and levels” shows where you stand.

post_removed.title: A post of yours was removed

ttl_proposed.title: Disappearing messages
ttl_proposed.body: Someone proposes that messages disappear after {days} days. Open the chat to agree.

group_transfer_proposed.title: {name} wants to hand “{group}” over to you

group_transfer_accepted.title: {name} takes over “{group}”
group_transfer_accepted.body: The hand-over takes effect after 48 hours; until then you can take it back.

group_owner_changed.title: {name} now leads “{group}”
group_owner_changed.body: The leadership of the group changed.

group_orphaned.title: “{group}” has no leadership anymore
group_orphaned.body: Members can ask to take over.

group_motion_opened_takeover.title: Vote in “{group}”
group_motion_opened_takeover.body: About taking over the leadership. Vote in the group.

group_motion_opened_recall.title: Vote in “{group}”
group_motion_opened_recall.body: About recalling the leadership. Vote in the group.

group_delete_requested.title: “{group}” is to be deleted
group_delete_requested.body: For good on {date}. Download the data first.

group_archived.title: “{group}” was archived
group_archived.body: The group can only be read now.

initiative_author_invite.title: {by} invites you as a co-author
initiative_author_invite.body: On “{title}”. Open the initiative to accept or decline.

initiative_author_declined.title: {name} declined
initiative_author_declined.body: The invitation to “{title}” was not accepted.

initiative_author_removed.title: You were removed as an author
initiative_author_removed.body: The authors of “{title}” decided so by majority.

responsibility_transfer.title: {by} wants to hand a responsibility over to you
responsibility_transfer.body: “{title}”. Open account menu → Settings to accept.

responsibility_unanswered.title: Request marked as unanswered
responsibility_unanswered.body: A request to you is overdue and shows publicly as unanswered.

responsibility_dispute.title: Dispute against your responsibility
responsibility_dispute.body: “{title}”. You have time to show evidence.

dispute_jury_invite.title: You are on a jury
dispute_jury_invite.body: It is about the responsibility “{title}”. Please decide.

responsibility_reconfirm.title: Confirm a responsibility again
responsibility_reconfirm.body: “{title}” has to be confirmed again soon.

resource_suggestion.title: Suggestion from {by}
resource_suggestion.body: For “{title}”. You can accept or decline it.

resource_transfer.title: {by} wants to hand a document over to you

violation_notice.title: Notice about a post
violation_notice.body: Case {case_no}: a post broke a rule. This is your first violation. You can appeal once.

violation_warning.title: Warning
violation_warning.body: Case {case_no}: second violation. You now have a short write pause. You can appeal.

violation_suspension.title: Suspension
violation_suspension.body: Case {case_no}: third violation. Your account is suspended for some days. You can appeal.

violation_review.title: Review by the platform
violation_review.body: Case {case_no}: further violations. A platform admin looks at your case.

emergency_hidden.title: Post hidden for now
emergency_hidden.body: Case {case_no}: because of an emergency report the platform reviews a post of yours.

emergency_cleared.title: Post visible again
emergency_cleared.body: Case {case_no}: the review found no violation.

emergency_review.title: Emergency report
emergency_review.body: Case {case_no}: please review. The content is hidden.

admin_proposal.title: Approval needed
admin_proposal.body: An admin proposes a change that a second admin has to confirm.

emergency_access.title: Emergency access to a chat
emergency_access.body: Two admins looked briefly into a chat of yours, with a reason. This is noted in the log.

invite_used.title: {name} followed your invitation
invite_used.body: You now vouch for this person for 30 days.

invitee_violation.title: Notice about an invited person
invitee_violation.body: Case {case_no}: a person you invited broke the rules.

object_shared.title: “{title}” was shared with you
object_shared.body: You may read{write, select, true { and edit} other {}} it.

expense_payment.title: Payment in “{group}”
expense_payment.body: {name} noted a payment of {amount} that involves you.

duty_cover.title: Cover wanted: “{title}”
duty_cover.body: {name} cannot make it on {when}. Can you?
